nights.title: The OBGMs: Heart Problems Tour
nights.name: The OBGMs
nights.extract: The OBGMs (The oOohh Baby Gimme Mores) are a Canadian punk rock band from Toronto, Ontario. They are most noted for their 2020 album The Ends, which was a shortlisted finalist for the 2021 Polaris Music Prize.

nights.title: Em Beihold: Tales Of A Failed Shapeshifter Tour
nights.name: Em Beihold
nights.extract: Emily Mahin Beihold is an American singer-songwriter. She released her debut EP Infrared in 2017. After signing to Republic Records in 2021, she released her major-label debut single "Numb Little Bug" in 2022, which brought her widespread recognition. The same year, she released her second EP, Egg in the Backseat. Her debut album, Tales of a Failed Shapeshifter, was released on February 27, 2026.

nights.title: Dirty Honey
nights.name: Dirty Honey
nights.extract: Dirty Honey is an American rock band from Los Angeles, formed in 2017. It consists of singer Marc LaBelle, guitarist John Notto, bassist Justin Smolian, and drummer Jaydon Bean.
